decisions.quote: Our findings replicated our earlier work across a number of volumetric and white matter measures confirming that asymmetry is more robust at detecting differences between TD and ADHD brains.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly conclude that their findings replicated their earlier work and confirmed the central claim that inter-hemispheric asymmetry is more robust at detecting differences between TD and ADHD brains. Replicating across a subset of measures without framing any tested finding as a failure to replicate the original study establishes a successful outcome rather than mixed.
